systems.system: Disaster Recovery Site for the National Data Centre (RSTP Phase 2)
systems.platform: secondary data centre financed by India Exim Bank US$10.4m line of credit; not built (undrawn, project stalled in Lubombo Region; a later report places it in Siteki); main site place not stated
systems.owner: Government of Eswatini / Royal Science and Technology Park

note: The disaster recovery site is financed and planned, not in service (2026-09-22 and 2026-10-05 developments say the project stalled, loan undrawn bar a 1 percent development disbursement), so it is a systems entry and no fact.
